question: Should Crabfleet’s native saved-host experience permanently include per-profile Wake-on-LAN metadata and an opt-in automatic wake-and-retry mode?
rationale: The patch adds durable user-facing configuration and a new connection-recovery behavior; code review cannot determine whether that product surface is desired long-term.

options.title: Sponsor the native-client feature
options.body: Accept Wake-on-LAN as a supported saved-host capability once real-device and upgrade behavior are demonstrated.

options.title: Limit to manual wake
options.body: Retain the manual Wake action but remove automatic retry to reduce connection-policy surface and unintended packets.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR if Wake-on-LAN should instead be handled through a different host-management workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the native-client feature
recommendation.body: Accept Wake-on-LAN as a supported saved-host capability once real-device and upgrade behavior are demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as the only concrete contributor across the newly introduced Wake-on-LAN surface.
